title: Pokémon Ultra Sun
tested: The base game (v1.0, no update): new game in German from the language screen through Kukui's call, the name entry, the opening cutscenes and the title logo to the bedroom; walking there, the X menu, saving with Y, and after a restart Continue from that save. Not tested: anything after the bedroom (no battle), long sessions. With my copy of the v1.2 update the game stays black (it does in an emulator too), so these scripts build the base game. Seen on Linux with software Vulkan (llvmpipe in WSL2) only: the title screen's animation stays white, then black, before the Continue menu's result (the bedroom) shows correctly; on Windows with a real GPU the title is right. Also on a low-budget machine (Batocera Linux mini PC, AMD Ryzen 3 PRO 4350GE, Radeon Vega 6): the same new-game route and the Continue route, started from the system's menu, with a photo of the screen checked for each; 60 shown / 30 game pictures a second once the shaders of a scene are cached. The first time a scene is shown its shaders are compiled, which drops the game to as low as 8 to 20 pictures a second for up to a minute (measured in Pokémon X's opening); the cache is kept.
